name: Match Gender
description: Match each item's Gender to its assigned slot's Division Gender.

name: Match Division
description: Match each item's Division to its assigned slot's Division.

name: Match Available Practice Nights
description: Match each item's Practice Nights to its assigned slot's Practice Night.

name: Honor Coach's Child Request
description: Match each item's Coach Child Request to its assigned slot's ID.

name: Minimum Team Size
description: Limit each slot to at least 9 assigned items.

name: Maximum Standard Team Size
description: Limit standard division slots to at most 10 assigned items.

name: Maximum Larger Team Size
description: Limit larger division slots to at most 11 assigned items.

name: Balance Average Heights
description: Balance the average item's Height across all slots.

name: Distribute Tallest Players
description: Distribute the values of each item's Height evenly across all slots.

name: Group Teammate Requests
description: Group each item with items whose IDs are in its Teammate Requests.

name: Honor Coach Requests
description: Match each item's Coach Request to its assigned slot's ID.

name: Match Sibling Practice Nights
description: Align each item's assigned slot's Practice Night with its Sibling's assigned slot's Practice Night.

name: Match Sibling Gym
description: Align each item's assigned slot's Gym Location with its Sibling's assigned slot's Gym Location.

name: Balance Evaluation Scores
description: Balance the average item's Evaluation Score across all slots.
